name: com.trtc.tuikit.common.ForegroundService
description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit starts this foreground service during an active RTC audio or video session and shows the session title and description in a notification. It is marked for microphone and camera foreground use so the session can continue while the app is not on screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt Tencent RTC calls when the app moves to the background.
